senses.gloss: m. (פְּרַק) solution of a problem, reply, argument, opp. קושיא.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:21">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>האי קושיא … האי פ׳ והאי פ׳</he> such and such a problem and such and such a solution.
Ab. Zar. 30ᵃ פ׳ לסכנתא (Rashi פֵּירוּקֵי pl.) you offer argument where danger to life is concerned? a. e.—Pl. פֵּירוּקֵי, פּר׳.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84a:17">B. Mets. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>ומפריקנא ליה … פ׳</he> and I gave him twenty-four answers.
<cite ref="Horayot 13b:16">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>כתבי פ׳ ושדי</he> they wrote down answers and cast them (into the schoolhouse); a. e.
